note: Fixed narrator lines. They never contain guests' names. audio is the file name: a Show Pack keeps it in its own audio/ folder. Without the file, the line shows as a caption only.

lines.text: Right, sit down and sort yourselves out. Let's see how clued-up you actually are.
Bang on! Look at you, proper clued-up.
Not even close, mate! Did you bang your head on the way in?
Bloody hell, lightning fingers over here! Calm down, it's only a game.
Put the tea down and tap the screen! You've missed the bloody boat!
Ooh, that's a shocker. Check your phone, there's a forfeit with your name on it.
It is absolute carnage at the top of the board.
Well, that's your lot. Go and wash your mouths out with soap.
